name: OpenClaw Debug CI
description: Run the fixed OpenClaw debug-ci flow with read scope and output verification.

steps.description: Run the bounded OpenClaw debug-ci task via the dedicated task wrapper

constraints: The flow id is fixed to debug-ci
Execution is fixed to read scope with no escalation
Outputs must pass OpenClaw verification before the recipe completes
invariants: No alternate OpenClaw flow can be substituted at runtime
No scope other than read is allowed for this recipe
A failed verification blocks recipe success
